items.source: Typically WebServiceServerTest is used in combination with @MockitoBean or @Import to create any collaborators required by your Endpoint beans.
items.translation: 通常，WebServiceServerTest 与@MockitoBean或@Import结合使用，以创建您的Endpoint 所需的任何协作对象。

items.source: If you are looking to load your full application configuration and use MockWebServiceClient, you should consider @SpringBootTest combined with @AutoConfigureMockWebServiceClient rather than this annotation.
items.translation: 如果您希望加载完整的应用程序配置并使用 MockWebServiceClient，您应考虑使用@SpringBootTest与@AutoConfigureMockWebServiceClient组合，而不是使用此注解。

items.source: Determines if default filtering should be used with @SpringBootApplication. By default only @Endpoint (when no explicit controllers are defined) are included.
items.translation: 确定是否应使用默认过滤功能与@SpringBootApplication。默认情况下，仅包含@Endpoint（当未显式定义任何controllers时）。

items.source: Specifies the endpoints to test. This is an alias of endpoints() which can be used for brevity if no other attributes are defined. See endpoints() for details.
items.translation: 指定要测试的端点。这是 endpoints() 的别名，如果未定义其他属性，可用作简写形式。有关详细信息，请参阅 endpoints()。

items.source: Properties in form key=value that should be added to the Spring Environment before the test runs.
items.translation: 要在测试运行之前添加到 Spring Environment 的 form key=value 格式的属性。

items.source: Specifies the endpoints to test. May be left blank if all @Endpoint beans should be added to the application context.
items.translation: 指定要测试的端点。如果希望将所有 @Endpoint Bean 添加到应用程序上下文中，可以留空。

items.translation: 应应用于此测试的自动配置排除项。

items.source:
A set of exclude filters which can be used to filter beans that would otherwise be
added to the application context.
items.translation: 一组排除过滤器，可用于过滤本应添加到应用上下文的 Bean。

items.source:
A set of include filters which can be used to add otherwise filtered beans to the
application context.
items.translation: 一组包含过滤器，可用于将其他过滤器排除的 bean 添加到应用程序上下文中。
